rows.text_en: Defense Acquisition Program Administration ( Technology Protection Division ), 02-2079-6982
Ministry of National Defense ( Power Policy Division ), 02-748-5613

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「방위산업기술 보호법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Defense Industry Technology Protection Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(이해관계인의 의견 진술) 「방위산업기술 보호법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제12조제2항에 따른 이해관계인 의견 진술서는 별지 제1호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Statement of Opinion by Interested Parties) The statement of opinion by interested parties pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Defense Industry Technology Protection Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) is as in Form No. 1 attached hereto .

rows.source_ko: 제3조(방위산업기술 판정 신청 등) ① 영 제13조제1항에 따른 방위산업기술 판정 신청서는 별지 제2호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Application for Defense Industry Technology Determination, etc.) ①The application for defense industry technology determination pursuant to Article 13 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 2 .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제13조제4항에 따른 방위산업기술 판정서는 별지 제3호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The Defense Industry Technology Assessment Certificate pursuant to Article 13 , Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree is in the form of Annex 3 .

rows.source_ko: 제4조(방위산업기술 유출 및 침해 신고) 영 제16조제1항에 따른 방위산업기술 유출 및 침해 신고서 또는 조사 및 조치 요청서는 별지 제4호서식과 같다. <개정 2021. 6. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Reporting of Leakage and Infringement of Defense Industry Technology) The report on leakage and infringement of defense industry technology or the request for investigation and measures pursuant to Article 16 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Attached Form . <Amended June 22, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제4조의2(조사) ① 「방위산업기술 보호법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제11조의2제2항에 따른 출석요구서, 같은 조 제3항에 따른 보고요구서 및 같은 조 제4항에 따른 자료제출요구서는 각각 별지 제5호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 4-2 (Investigation) ① The summons for attendance pursuant to Article 11-2, Paragraph 2 of the Defense Industry Technology Protection Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the request for report pursuant to Paragraph 3 of the same Article, and the request for submission of materials pursuant to Paragraph 4 of the same Article shall each be in accordance with Form No. 5 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제11조의2제5항에 따른 현장출입조사서는 별지 제6호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The on-site entry and exit survey form pursuant to Article 11-2, Paragraph 5 of the Act is as in Form No. 6 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제16조의2제1항에 따른 발송확인대장은 별지 제7호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The dispatch confirmation ledger pursuant to Article 16-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 7 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제16조의2제3항에 따른 조사 연기 신청서는 별지 제8호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ④ The application for postponement of investigation pursuant to Article 16-2, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree is in the form of Annex 8 .

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 영 제16조의2제4항에 따른 조사 연기 신청 결과 통지서는 별지 제9호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The notice of results of the application for postponement of investigation pursuant to Article 16-2, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 9 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 영 제16조의2제5항에 따른 의견제출서는 별지 제10호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The statement of opinion pursuant to Article 16-2, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 10 .

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 영 제16조의2제6항에 따른 조사 결과 통지서는 별지 제11호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The notice of investigation results pursuant to Article 16-2, Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 11 .
[This Article Newly Inserted June 22, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제4조의3(외국인 및 복수국적자에 의한 방위산업기술 유출방지를 위한 관리 계획 수립) 영 제18조의2제1항에 따라 대상기관의 장이 작성하여 방위사업청장에게 제출해야 하는 외국인 및 복수국적자 관리 계획서는 별지 제11호의2서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 4-3 (Establishment of Management Plan to Prevent Leakage of Defense Industry Technology by Foreigners and Dual Nationals) The management plan for foreigners and dual nationals that the head of the target agency must prepare and submit to the Administrator of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration pursuant to Article 18-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 11-2 of the Attached Form.

[This Article was newly added on Sep. 10, 2026.]
[Formerly Article 4-3 was moved to Article 4-4 <September 10, 2026>]

rows.source_ko: 제4조의4(방위산업기술 보호지원 전담기관의 지정신청 등) ① 영 제21조의2제2항에서 “국방부령으로 정하는 전담기관 지정신청서”란 별지 제12호서식의 방위산업기술 보호지원 전담기관 지정신청서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4-4 (Application for Designation of Agency for Protection and Support of Defense Industry Technology, etc.) ① In Article 21-2, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “application form for designation of an agency prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of National Defense” refers to the application form for designation of an agency for protection and support of defense industry technology in Annex 12.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제21조의2제2항에 따라 전담기관 지정신청서를 제출받은 방위사업청장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통해 법인 등기사항증명서를 확인해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Administrator of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration, upon receiving an application for designation as a specialized agency pursuant to Article 21-2, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, shall verify the certificate of corporate registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제21조의2제3항에서 “국방부령으로 정하는 전담기관 지정서”란 별지 제13호서식의 방위산업기술 보호지원 전담기관 지정서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In Article 21-2 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “designation certificate for a dedicated agency prescribed by the Ministry of National Defense Ordinance” refers to the designation certificate for a dedicated agency for the protection and support of defense industry technology in Form No. 13 of the Attached Form.

[This Article newly inserted June 2, 2025]
[Moved from Article 4-3 <September 10, 2026>]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(포상금의 지급기준) ① 영 제22조제2항에 따른 포상금의 지급기준은 별표와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Criteria for Payment of Rewards) ①The criteria for payment of rewards pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree are as set forth in the attached table .

rows.source_ko: ② 포상 및 포상금의 세부적인 지급 방법 등에 관하여 필요한 사항은 방위사업청장이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Administrator of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration shall determine necessary matters regarding the detailed payment methods, etc., of awards and reward money .
